text_block_list.text:
My usual clothing store was having a sale, 
so when I went to shop—

text_block_list.name: Fashionable Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
This is so cute! It was featured in that 
magazine, wasn't it?!

text_block_list.name: Trend-Loving Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
How about you, Nature? I think this color 
would really suit you.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"No, no, I'm good, really. This kind of 
stuff just isn't my style."

text_block_list.name: Fashionable Umamusume
text_block_list.text: That's not true at all~!

text_block_list.name: Trend-Loving Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
We're gonna go try some on. Nature, you 
wanna try one too if you like?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Ah, yeah, yeah. If I feel like it.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Oh, what a coincidence. Are you picking 
out clothes too, Trainer?
choice_data_list: I wanted to stock up while the sale is on.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I see~. Though for someone saying that, 
your basket looks rather empty?
choice_data_list:
There are so many clothes that I can't 
decide.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... In that case, shall Nature make a 
quick and speedy decision for ya?
choice_data_list:
More importantly, what about those cute 
clothes you were looking at earlier?

I'd love to! But are your friends okay 
with that?
I'd love to! But what about your friends?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... In that case, shall Nature make a 
quick and speedy decision for ya?
choice_data_list:
More importantly, what about those cute 
clothes you were looking at earlier?

I'd love to! But are your friends okay 
with that?
I'd love to! But what about your friends?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"They told me it suited me, but all these 
frills just aren't really my style, you 
know?"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Yours truly, Nature-san, is perfectly 
fine with something far more modest."
choice_data_list: Not at all, it suits you!
That's not true, it looks great on you!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
L-Like I said, you don't have to flatter 
me.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
You came here to buy clothes, right? Why 
don't you go look around without worrying 
about others?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Look, even if you make that pouty face, 
Nature-san is not wearing that, okay?
choice_data_list:
It would definitely suit you so well, 
though...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Now, now, don't pout. You're a grown 
adult, so just give it up.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Well, if it's just holding the clothes up 
against myself, I suppose I could do that 
for you?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Seriously, only for a little bit, okay...?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: —All right, all done!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Uuu, when it's over, it's over! No matter 
what anyone says, we're done~.
choice_data_list: It really did look great on you!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: …………Oh, okay.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Geez... if you're satisfied, scram, scram! 
Actually, forget it, I'm the one getting 
out of here!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
See ya, Trainer! Make sure you forget what 
you just saw!

Saying that, Nice Nature dashed off before 
I could even stop her.

The clothes she took with her as she left 
were the ones the two of us had just been 
looking at.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"I was just tagging along anyway, and they 
told me, 'You can leave halfway through if 
you want.'"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Wait here a moment. I'll go explain things 
to those kids.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for waiting. Well then, shall we 
get going!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I wonder what would look good on you, 
Trainer. You might actually be able to 
pull off something flashy.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Choosing is fun, yeah. Being chosen, 
though... not so much.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Even if someone recommends cute clothes, 
they don't look good on me, so I feel bad.
choice_data_list: I think it suits you, though.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Geez. Not you too, Trainer~

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"You're picking out your own clothes, 
right? Forget about me! Just forget I'm 
here!"

Thanks to Nice Nature, I was able to find 
plenty of clothes to my liking.

"As a result, I ended up having to carry a 
heavy load of luggage on the way back, 
but..."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Well now, valued customer, you sure bought 
a whole lot, didn't ya?
choice_data_list: Thanks to Nice Nature's good eye.

Thanks to Nice Nature's good eye, you 
know.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Well, I'm not her Trainer for nothing, you 
know?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I'm keeping a proper eye on you, Trainer, 
believe it or not.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
So with that, hand over one of those bags, 
would you?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Your arms have been trembling for a while 
now... I can hardly bear to watch..."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Don't be so stubborn, you're a grown 
adult!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Up we go. Come on, let's get moving 
already, okay?

As she pointed out, my arms were at their 
limit, so I gladly accepted Nice Nature's 
kindness and headed back to the academy.
